Lexora Global Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 07/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Intimation is hereby given that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on Saturday, 7th November, 2026, at Registered office of the Company to transact, with or without modifications the following business: 
1. To consider and approve Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results of the company for the period ended on September 30, 2026.
2.   Any other business matter, with the permission of the Chair.
